title: UDP Send
text: Send data over UDP network to a remote device, 2 inputs, {Local port} sets Source UDP port to transmit data no; {Use host-target connection} uses Ethernet connection between development and target, {To IP address} sets the iP address of target, {To port} sets the uDP port of target device, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the sample time of block, {Enable Simulink messages} sets the data as messages and {Local IP address} sets the source IP address for sending data no. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Length
ports.summary: Number of bytes of data to transmit double

params.name: Use host-target connection
params.values: Use Ethernet connection between development and target computers ’off’ (default) | ’on’

params.name: To IP address
params.values: IP address of target device 10.10.10.10 (default) | x.x.x.x

params.name: Local IP address
params.values: Source IP address for sending data no value (default) | x.x.x.x

params.name: Local port
params.values: Source UDP port to transmit data no value (default) | 0–65535 | -1
